title: Hidden Veggie Paratha
subtitle: Soft multigrain parathas with broccoli, spinach, peas and paneer blended into the dough.
protein: ~15–17g protein per adult serving (2 parathas; paneer, hemp hearts and besan carry most of it)

items.name: Plain yogurt or chutney, to serve

method.title: Steam and blend the purée
items: Steam {@peas}, {@broccoli}, {@spinach} and {@cashews} together until tender, 5–6 min (or on the Instant Pot steam rack, 1 min on high pressure)
Let the vegetables cool until just warm
Add {@water} a splash at a time until the purée is thick and smooth

method.title: Make the dough
items: In a wide bowl, mix {@wheat}, {@besan}, {@jowar} and {@oats}
Knead into a soft, slightly sticky dough
Cover and rest 10 min; the besan, jowar and oats absorb moisture and firm it up

method.label: Toddler — pull portion here (before the spice blend)
items: Pinch off {=2 lime-size balls} of dough for her now, before the adults' spice blend goes in
Roll thin and cook on a medium tawa with {@ghee} spread over both sides, 1–2 min per side, until soft and lightly golden
Cut into strips and serve with {@serving-yogurt|plain yogurt}; keep any chili chutney for adults

method.title: Spice, roll and cook
items: Divide into equal lime-size balls; roll each into a {=~6 inch} round with light dusting
Heat a tawa or flat pan on medium-high
Cook each paratha about 1 min until it puffs slightly, then flip
Spread {@ghee} over both sides; press gently and cook 1–2 min per side until golden spots appear

method.label: Tip
method.text: Jowar and oats flours have no gluten, so this dough is more fragile than plain roti dough: rest it, roll gently and patch cracks with your fingers. Substitution: garlic → hing + ginger for the savoury depth.
